svg.title: The Pecos YAML, line by line, and the map it describes
svg.desc: Animated: the layout file on the left with the lines of each step highlighted, the Pecos floor on the right with the elements those lines create: windows and buffer, a parking node, a rotation waypoint, a bay, a charger, the edges and the section comments.
svg.metadata: ["Top level. The parser reads name, parking_window_buffer, parking_windows, nodes and edges here; floors, vrcs and rotation_circle_tape_radius are absent, so Pecos gets one floor {id 0, z 0} and the default tape radius. Unknown keys would be ignored silently. Grey dots: the 28 nodes, not yet explained.", "parking_windows and the buffer set the stall size. XL is 5.791 m along the facing (body +x, the AGV's long axis; world x at heading 90) by 2.21 m. The parser appends TRAY and sorts by area: TRAY 0, COMPACT 1, STANDARD 2, LARGE 3, XL 4. The buffer (+0.1524, +0.0762) is added only for the PoseGraph's sized-pose overlaps; with it, P19's footprint reaches 0.15 m into P20's.", "One Parking node: id 19 at (37.1856, 19.4523), XL, headings [90]. GetAllowedHeadings adds the reciprocal, so P19 has two poses: 90 (facing west) and -90 (facing east), each with the same XL rectangle. The other nine Parking nodes are the same shape.", "A rotation waypoint: node 8, headings [0, 90], rotation_allowed true. Four poses (-90, 0, 90, 180) and, because it may rotate, ROT_LEFT / ROT_RIGHT neighbours and a circular footprint of radius hypot(5.9434, 2.2862) / 2 = 3.18 m instead of a rectangle. W22 is the only other node like it.", "A Bay: node 21, headings [90], faces_reciprocal true. Inbound heading = Wrap(90 + 180) = -90: an AGV in the bay faces east, through the door on the garage side towards W41. No prioritization_value, so it counts as 0 and the bay order is [21, 7] (ties go to the higher id).", "An AgvCharge node: id 14, 0.6096 m south of P15, max_resource_size TRAY (index 0, so no payload may stand there), faces_reciprocal true. Its charging pose is (14, -90): facing east. C16 is the same; C10 has faces_reciprocal false, so it charges at 90.", "The edges list: 37 undirected edges (src/dst order is discarded). They draw the graph: three columns of waypoints and stalls, the bay spurs W31 and W41, and the 0.61 m charger spurs.", "The comments. # 5675_pecos_sandbox_eng and # 5675_pecos_sandbox_qa split the nodes into two sandboxes, joined only by edge 8-13 (4.391 m); # Offset \"origin\" on node 22 marks the measurement datum. The parser throws comments away, but they change the md5 and so force a collision-table rebuild.", "Everything: 28 nodes (13 waypoints, 10 parking, 3 chargers, 2 bays), 37 edges, 4 windows plus TRAY, two sandboxes. This is the map every other Pecos figure draws."]
